qualification.details: Nationality: Indian nationals, including Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955. Cut-off date: Qualifications, experience and other eligibility conditions will be reckoned as on the last date of submission of the Application Form. Minimum standard: The prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum. Having them does not by itself entitle an applicant to be called for interview. Relaxation in marks: Relaxation in the percentage of marks will be given as per the rule of the Government of India, wherever applicable. Madrasa background: A certificate equivalent to High School or Graduation will be considered if it was obtained from a Madaris/Institution recognized by the University, wherever applicable. | Check the official notification and the NMC norms/Residency Scheme adopted by AMU for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: The Application Form can be filled only in Online Mode on the University's Careers Portal (https://careers.amuonline.ac.in). The printed form then goes to the Dean's office by post. Applications on plain paper, incomplete forms, and forms received late or without the supporting documents will be summarily rejected.

Fill in the Application Form online on the Careers Portal by 4 November 2026 (upto 11:59 P.M.), following the instructions in the advertisement and the User Manual on the portal. Fill a separate form for each post if you are applying under more than one serial number of the advertisement.

Pay the non-refundable Processing Fee of Rs. 500/- for each Application Form, online only on the Careers Portal. PwD candidates do not pay this fee if they upload an authentic Disability Certificate in the prescribed Proforma with the form.
After you submit the form, print the PDF of the Application Form on A-4 size paper.
Sign the printout and paste a recent front-facing photograph in the designated place.
Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed below.

Send the complete form by post to the Office of the Dean, J. N. Medical College, Faculty of Medicine, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002. On the top-left side of the cover, write the post applied for, the advertisement number and its date.

Make sure the hard copy reaches the office by 12 November 2026 (04:00 p.m.). Hard copies will not be received after that time, and the University will not be responsible for postal delay or for late receipt or non-receipt.

The Local Selection Committee for eligible candidates will be held on 21 November 2026 in the Office of the Dean, Faculty of Medicine. Before that, the University may set up a committee to scrutinise the applications and shortlist applicants. It reserves the right to limit the number of applicants called for interview to a reasonable number, on the basis of Rules/Criteria or any other condition it thinks fit. No separate Notice/Interview letter will be issued for this schedule.
Report with all original documents to the office of the Dean, Faculty of Medicine, AMU, Aligarh, half an hour before the scheduled time of the L.S.C.
important_instructions: Requests to add any document or information to the Application Form after the last date of submission will not be entertained. For posts earmarked for PwD candidates, only persons with at least 40% of the relevant disability may apply. They must upload a Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma (Appendix-1, available on the Careers Portal) issued by the Competent Authority. The applicable categories of disability are: (A) Blindness and low vision (VH); (B) Deaf and hard of hearing (HH); (C) Locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid-attack victims and muscular dystrophy (OH); (D) Autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness; (E) Multiple disabilities from amongst persons under clauses (A) to (D) including deaf-blindness. The Appendix-1 Proforma is available on https://www.amu.ac.in, https://www.amuregistrar.com and https://careers.amuonline.ac.in. The University Medical Board will examine the disability claim of a selected applicant before the appointment letter is issued. For help with the form, read the User Manual on the Careers Portal or call the Help Desk on +91-571-2700920 (Extension: 1178) during office hours on working days. Updates, if any, appear on the Careers Portal.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Enclose attested photocopies of these documents with the application form, and bring the originals of all of them for verification at the interview. A candidate without the originals will not be allowed to appear in the interview. All marksheets, certificates and degrees from class Xth to postgraduation Internship completion Certificate Valid Registration of Graduation and Post graduation from NMC Other testimonial(s) Experience Certificate No Objection Certificate from the present employer, if employed, and relieving orders from all previous employers The general instructions also make self-attested copies of the following mandatory for all Teaching positions filled through the Local Selection Committee. If they are missing, the form will be summarily rejected: High School Certificate from a Recognized Board Mark-sheet and Degree of Graduation Mark-sheet and Degree of Post-Graduation Certificate of NET, JRF, SLET/SET, CSIR etc. as the case may be M. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AMU JNMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 Senior Resident posts: 2 in the Department of T.B. & Respiratory Diseases and 1 in the Department of Surgery. The number and nature of the posts may vary at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AMU Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The online form must be submitted by 4 November 2026 (upto 11:59 P.M.). The hard copy must reach the Dean's office by 12 November 2026 (04:00 p.m.).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the AMU JNMC Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The qualifications for both posts are as per NMC norms/Residency Scheme, adopted by AMU. They are reckoned as on the last date of submission of the Application Form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of a Senior Resident in AMU JNMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Senior Resident posts are at Pay Level AL-11.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The non-refundable Processing Fee is Rs. 500/- for each Application Form, paid online on the Careers Portal. PwD candidates are exempted if they upload an authentic Disability Certificate on the prescribed Proforma.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for AMU JNMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online at https://careers.amuonline.ac.in, then print the form, sign it, paste a photograph and attach self-attested documents. Post it to the Office of the Dean, J. N. Medical College, Faculty of Medicine, Aligarh Muslim University, Aligarh-202002, writing the post, advertisement number and date on the top-left of the cover.

faq.question: Q7. When is the interview for the AMU Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The Local Selection Committee meets on 21 November 2026 in the Office of the Dean, Faculty of Medicine. It meets at 12:30 p.m. for T.B. & Respiratory Diseases (reporting 12:00 noon) and at 01:00 p.m. for Surgery (reporting 12:30 p.m.). No separate interview letter will be issued.

faq.question: Q8. Is the AMU Senior Resident job permanent?
faq.answer: No. Appointments will be made on a purely temporary basis, subject to termination at any time without notice or assignment of reason.

faq.question: Q9. Can OCI Cardholders apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Applications are invited from Indian nationals, including Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) Cardholders under Section-7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for both Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Yes. A separate Application Form must be filled for each post listed under a different serial number of the advertisement, and each form carries its own Processing Fee of Rs. 500/-.
